method.kind: read-only audit of installed Kicker and DomainOS activation paths

kicker_menu_item.behavior: On each MouseArea.onReleased for a leaf item, calls model.trigger and sets kicker.expanded=false.

domainos_application_entry.behavior: ItemDelegate.onClicked dispatches the selected filtered entry; no explicit double-click debounce in this handler.

domainos_pinned_application.behavior: launchPin calls commands.openApplication and closes the popup.

launcher.behavior: launch_desktop submits one request to kioclient6/kioclient or gtk-launch and reports launcher acceptance; it does not observe application completion.

interpretation.finding: Neither audited path has a handler explicitly dedicated to suppressing a second activation. This does not establish that a physical double-click dispatches twice after the popup closes.
interpretation.plasma_restart_cause: unknown; no correlated live reproduction or coredump evidence was produced

next: Keep the user's double-click/restart report separate from the open-menu hover/focus issue.
If the report recurs with a timestamp, correlate it to plasmashell journal/coredump and reproduce in an isolated menu session before changing activation semantics.
